name: KERA

plaster.note: The default page ground. Sampled from the build at #101c31 with the fixed mottle over it.

cinnabar-deep.note: The inscription band's ground. Gilt on it reads 6.6:1.

ochre.note: Takes every job gold is forbidden from: section labels, static icons, the plaque rule.

chalk-3.note: 4.7:1 on plaster — the floor. Do not darken further.

gilt.note: Rationed by law to what is alight: the primary action, a firing arch, today's build stage, the live element, the inscription band.

authoredMoment.name: the arch fires
steps: gilt outline clipPath inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0), 1.15s, from t=0.1
authoredMoment.trigger: ScrollTrigger top 82%, once; the hero fires on load at delay 0.15

variations: split lines yPercent 128 → 0 behind a mask
motion.fallback: The page renders finished in CSS. An inline head script adds `.motion` only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and removes it after 3000ms if `document.documentElement.dataset.fired` was never set.

arch.outline: same path, open at the bottom, stroke 1.25 non-scaling, masked to fade below 30%

braid.pattern: 46×14 userSpaceOnUse, two mirrored cubic waves crossing at the midline

rules: Gold is gilding: the live action, a firing arch, today's stage, the live element, the inscription band. Nothing else.
Hierarchy from size and pigment, never from font weight — the display face has one weight.
The page renders finished; only `.motion` un-finishes it.
Every photograph takes the arch, and every arch fires.
A fact that is not settled is written as a sentence, never guessed and never left blank.
northStar: The inside of a Georgian mountain church, at the moment a door opens onto the valley.
